entries.title: Fourier entropy-influence conjecture: exact uniform Boolean scope
entries.statement: CONJECTURE: there exists a finite universal C such that for every n and every f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}, with fhat(S)=E[f(X) product_{j in S} X_j] under uniform independent signs, H_2(f)=sum_{S subset [n]} fhat(S)^2 log_2(1/fhat(S)^2) <= C I(f), where I(f)=sum_S |S| fhat(S)^2 and zero summands are zero. The dated intake P0162 ranking is historical; current global openness was not certified by w505.

entries.title: Boolean Fourier entropy restriction deficit
entries.statement: For f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}, normalized uniform Walsh coefficients and base-2 Fourier spectral entropy H_2(f), define f_+ and f_- by fixing coordinate i to +1 and -1, and Delta_i(f)=H_2(f)-(H_2(f_+)+H_2(f_-))/2. The coordinate influence is I_i(f)=sum_{S containing i} fhat(S)^2. The deficit ratio Delta_i/I_i is defined only when I_i>0.

entries.title: Explicit Boolean obstruction to all-coordinate FEI restriction induction
entries.statement: For every m>=1, let N=2^(2m), u,v be independent uniform vectors in F_2^m, y an independent uniform sign, and F_m(u,v,y)=(-1)^(u dot v)-(1-y)1{u=v=0}. Then F_m is Boolean, its selector influence is I_y=1/N, and its base-2 Fourier restriction deficit satisfies Delta_y(F_m)/I_y>=log_2((2^m-1)^2+1). Consequently there is no finite universal C with Delta_i(f)<=C I_i(f) for every uniform-cube Boolean f and every coordinate i. This does not refute the full FEI conjecture or its sufficient exists-coordinate input; no novelty is claimed. The same family satisfies I(F_m)=m+(2m+1)/N and H_2(F_m)<=2I(F_m) for every m>=1.
entries.proof_text: Write B(u,v)=(-1)^(u dot v), d=1{u=v=0}, and F=(B-d)+y d. At the exceptional point F=y; elsewhere F=B, proving Booleanity. Summing characters over v first gives Bhat(alpha,beta)=2^-m(-1)^(alpha dot beta), while dhat=1/N. For a= Bhat-1/N, b=1/N, r=a^2+b^2, the exact entropy difference of each Fourier pair is r[h_2(b^2/r)+J(2ab/r)], where J(t)=1-h_2((1+t)/2)>=0. This is at least b^2 log_2(r/b^2). For every pair, r/b^2=(sigma 2^m-1)^2+1>=(2^m-1)^2+1. Summing N equal b^2 terms yields I_y=1/N and the claimed deficit lower bound. The lower bound tends to infinity. Independent referee w506 re-derived the Walsh identity and entropy lower bound and filed KEEP in P0162-REVIEW-W505-004; the truth-table check was separate corroboration. For the whole-family bound, each of the 2m base coordinate influences is 1/2+1/N: flipping the zero point changes two directed endpoint disagreements in the selector-minus restriction, and averaging the two selector restrictions gives this influence. Along with I_y=1/N this gives I=m+(2m+1)/N. Selector presence in the spectral subset has mass rho=1/N, and either conditional slice has at most N atoms, hence H_2(F_m)<=2m+h_2(rho). Since -(1-rho)ln(1-rho)<=rho, h_2(rho)<=2m rho+rho/ln(2)<=2(2m+1)rho for m>=1, giving H_2(F_m)<=2I(F_m). w506 separately checked C004. These are reviewed mathematical statements in a DRAFT; served-model and different-model promotion gates are not established.

entries.title: Unproved suitable-coordinate input for full FEI
entries.statement: UNPROVED INPUT: a universal finite C such that every nonconstant Boolean uniform-cube function has some positive-influence coordinate i satisfying Delta_i(f)<=C I_i(f), with the same C for all dimensions and all restrictions. Together with I(f)=I_i(f)+(I(f_+)+I(f_-))/2, it would prove FEI by induction from constants. The all-coordinate strengthening fails in the draft explicit witness; choosing a coordinate of maximal influence is not justified by this packet and prior owner work reports it fails. The missing work is a valid coordinate choice or a noncircular structural estimate in the small-influence regime.
assumptions: same universal C at every inductive step

relations.rationale: The witness uses exactly the defined Delta_y and I_y, with base-2 uniform Fourier normalization.
The unproved local input quantifies over Delta_i/I_i as defined, not H/I.
The exact influence recursion makes the clearly unproved local coordinate premise sufficient for the stated full FEI target.
The checked witness rules out an all-coordinate sufficient route to the exact FEI target; it does not refute the target itself.

The original P0162 attempt shows the Boolean constraint cannot be dropped; this witness retains Booleanity and pinpoints a different inadequate proof input, arbitrary-coordinate restriction induction.
